shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright stone monolith
carved animal in profile with legs
relief line/band running across the stone surface
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on tall, rough stone monoliths, and each includes a profile quadruped-like creature with a long low-relief band or line crossing the surface; that is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise A is a densely covered anthropomorphic block with a large disc, concentric motifs, chevron bands and a head, arranged in stacked registers, while B shows a single sparse, smoothly modelled animal above a curving line on an otherwise blank field — the density, subject and carving manner differ markedly.
